==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*pustìti}}.

===Pronunciation===

* {{audio|ru|Ru-пустить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|пусти́ть|pf|impf=пуска́ть}}

# to [[let]] ''(go)'', to [[allow]], to [[permit]], to [[release]]
# to set going, to set in motion, to set in operation, to [[start]], to set working
# to [[let in]]
# to [[launch]], to [[throw]]
# {{lb|ru|botany}} to [[sprout]], to [[put out]], to [[put forth]]
